questions.prompt: What conditions did coffee consumption reduce the risk of?
choices: Cirrhosis, liver cancer, and liver-related death
questions.hintKo: The study specifically looked at liver conditions: cirrhosis, liver cancer, and liver-related death.

hintI18n.en: The study specifically looked at liver conditions: cirrhosis, liver cancer, and liver-related death.

questions.prompt: Why do the benefits appear to come from antioxidants rather than caffeine?
choices: Because the study only looked at tea drinkers
Because coffee beans have no caffeine
Because decaffeinated drinkers showed similar benefits to regular coffee drinkers
Because caffeine was proven harmful to the liver
questions.hintKo: The similar results in decaf drinkers point to antioxidants as the source of the benefits.

hintI18n.en: The similar results in decaf drinkers point to antioxidants as the source of the benefits.
hintI18n.ko: 디카페인 커피를 마신 사람들에게서 비슷한 결과가 나온 것은 항산화제가 이점의 원천임을 보여줍니다.
hintI18n.zh-Hans: 无咖啡因饮用者也有类似结果，这说明益处来自抗氧化剂。
hintI18n.ja: デカフェを飲む人でも同様の結果が出たことは、利益の源が抗酸化物質であることを示しています。
hintI18n.es: Los resultados similares en quienes beben descafeinado indican que los antioxidantes son la fuente de los beneficios.
hintI18n.hi: डिकैफ़ पीने वालों में समान परिणाम बताते हैं कि लाभ के स्रोत एंटीऑक्सिडेंट हैं।
hintI18n.de: Die ähnlichen Ergebnisse bei Entkoffeiniert-Trinkern deuten darauf hin, dass Antioxidantien die Quelle der Vorteile sind.
hintI18n.vi: Kết quả tương tự ở người uống cà phê không caffeine cho thấy chất chống oxy hóa là nguồn mang lại lợi ích.
hintI18n.pt-BR: Os resultados semelhantes em quem bebe descafeinado indicam que os antioxidantes são a fonte dos benefícios.
hintI18n.id: Hasil serupa pada peminum kopi tanpa kafein menunjukkan antioksidan sebagai sumber manfaatnya.
hintI18n.fr: Les résultats similaires chez les buveurs de déca pointent vers les antioxydants comme source des bienfaits.
hintI18n.ar: تشير النتائج المماثلة لدى شاربي القهوة منزوعة الكافيين إلى أن مضادات الأكسدة هي مصدر الفوائد.
hintI18n.tr: Kafeinsiz içenlerdeki benzer sonuçlar, faydaların kaynağının antioksidanlar olduğuna işaret ediyor.
hintI18n.it: I risultati simili in chi beve decaffeinato indicano che gli antiossidanti sono la fonte dei benefici.
hintI18n.pl: Podobne wyniki u pijących kawę bezkofeinową wskazują, że źródłem korzyści są przeciwutleniacze.
